title: Karbala me imam Husain Akele nhi the #karbala #imamhusain
description:
Karbala ki jung 💔🔥 wo jung hai jise padh kar patthar dil insaan bhi ro padta hai 😢
Ye sirf ek tareekh nahi balki Islam ki hifazat ki sabse badi misaal hai 🕊️
Har bachcha jaanta hai ke
Imam Hussain (RA) ne apni jaan qurbaan karke ✨
Islam ko zinda rakha,
khud shaheed ho gaye lekin Islam ko mitne nahi diya ⚔️❤️
Lekin afsos 😔 kuch log samajhte hain ke
Karbala me Hazrat Ali (RA) ke sirf do bete the
👉 Imam Hussain (RA)
👉 Hazrat Abbas (RA)
Sach ye hai ke Karbala me
Hazrat Ali (RA) ke 5 bete maujood the 🌟
1️⃣ Imam Hussain bin Ali (RA)
2️⃣ Hazrat Abbas bin Ali (RA)
3️⃣ Hazrat Abu Bakr bin Ali (RA)
4️⃣ Hazrat Umar bin Ali (RA)
5️⃣ Hazrat Usman bin Ali (RA)
Teenon ke naam Khulafa-e-Rashideen ke naam par rakhe gaye the 🤍
Aur unhone bhi Karbala me
apne bhai Imam Hussain (RA) ke saath
apni jaan qurbaan kar di 🩸
lekin bhai ka saath kabhi nahi chhoda 💪🔥
Ye hai sachchi wafadari,
ye hai Islam ke liye qurbani ka jazba 🕋✨

#Karbala​ #ImamHussain​ #HazratAbbas​ #Shahadat​
